exposure: laparoscopic radical trachelectomy (LRT) with a 'no-look no-touch' technique
outcome: lengths of excised parametrium and vagina
cohort: The study included 40 women with early-stage cervical cancer who underwent laparoscopic radical trachelectomy (LRT) with a 'no-look no-touch' technique.
finding: The 'no-look no-touch' technique for laparoscopic radical trachelectomy (LRT) appears effective in reducing the risk of recurrence and improving obstetrical outcomes for women with early-stage cervical cancer.
mod_finding: Of the nine patients who attempted pregnancy, seven conceived (nine pregnancies), with eight babies delivered by term cesarean section and one pregnancy resulting in a first-trimester miscarriage.
